newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia's Ventspils beats last year's loadings.
newsitem.headline: Latvia's Ventspils beats last year's loadings.

text.p: Latvia's Ventspils oil terminal, one of the main outlets for Russian crude and oil products, said on Tuesday that it had already exceeded last year's loadings.
The port company said in a statement that by December 4 it had loaded 23.3 million tonnes of crude and oil products, three million tonnes more than in the whole of last year.
It said that in the first 11 months of 1997 it had loaded 13.06 million tonnes of crude, one million tonnes more than for the whole of 1995.
In November it loaded 1.31 million tonnes of oil, 200,000 tonnes more than in October, the company added.
The company also said diesel loadings increased to 8.5 million tonnes in the first 11 months, some 1.8 million tonnes more in than the whole of last year.
It said that late last month that it loaded the largest amount of oil onto one ship, when the Bona Rainbow took 88,800 tonnes of crude on board.
The port, still state-owned but on the list for privatisation, said next year it will accommodate vessels of 100,000 tonnes to 120,000 tonnes after reconstruction.
It currently services vessels of at least 75,000 tonnes.
